name: VinuChain Name Service
description: VinuChain Name Service (VNS) testnet deployment, ported from @ensdomains/ens-contracts v1.7.0 with the registrar and wrapper targeting the .vinu TLD.

contracts.name: VNSRegistry
contracts.description: Canonical VNS registry for name owner, resolver, and TTL records on VinuChain testnet.

contracts.name: Root
contracts.description: Ownable root controller that manages top-level VNS subnodes such as .vinu and reverse.

contracts.name: ReverseRegistrar
contracts.description: ENS-compatible addr.reverse registrar used for VNS primary-name reverse records.

contracts.name: DefaultReverseRegistrar
contracts.description: Standalone default.reverse registrar for chain-default reverse name records.

contracts.name: DefaultReverseResolver
contracts.description: Resolver for default.reverse records backed by DefaultReverseRegistrar.

contracts.name: VNSBaseRegistrar
contracts.description: ERC-721 base registrar for second-level .vinu names.

contracts.name: OwnedResolver
contracts.description: Owner-controlled resolver assigned to the .vinu node for interface records.

contracts.name: LegacyDummyOracle
contracts.description: Legacy static USD price oracle retained for provenance; no longer used by the active VNS registrar controller.

contracts.name: ExponentialPremiumPriceOracle
contracts.description: Active ENS exponential premium price oracle for VNS testnet registrations. It converts the owner-governed USD rent curve into the enforced VC payment amount using VinuUsdOracle at quote time.

contracts.name: StaticMetadataService
contracts.description: Static metadata URL service for wrapped VNS name tokens.

contracts.name: NameWrapper
contracts.description: Patched ENS NameWrapper using .vinu constants and DNS wire names.

contracts.name: VNSRegistrarController
contracts.description: Active patched ENS registrar controller that registers .vinu names, reads the real VinuUsdOracle-backed price oracle, and writes VNS reverse records.

contracts.name: VNSBulkRenewal
contracts.description: Bulk renewal helper for .vinu names that targets the active real-oracle VNS registrar controller.

contracts.name: VNSPublicResolver
contracts.description: Public resolver for VNS address, text, contenthash, interface, pubkey, and multicall records.

contracts.name: GatewayProvider
contracts.description: Gateway provider used by the universal resolver for offchain lookup routing.

contracts.name: UniversalResolver
contracts.description: ENS universal resolver deployed against the VNS registry.

contracts.name: VinuUsdOracle
contracts.description: Automated VC/USD conversion oracle used by the active VNS price oracle to enforce current VC name costs. Scheduled updates are sourced from CoinGecko and guarded by VinuSwap V3 TWAP fallback pricing.

contracts.name: LegacyExponentialPremiumPriceOracle
contracts.description: Legacy VNS premium price oracle that read the static DummyOracle before the real oracle-stack switch.

contracts.name: LegacyVNSRegistrarController
contracts.description: Legacy VNS registrar controller retained for provenance after controller permissions were moved to the real oracle stack.

contracts.name: LegacyVNSBulkRenewal
contracts.description: Legacy bulk renewal helper that targets the pre-switch VNS registrar controller.

contracts.name: PreviousVinuUsdOracle
contracts.description: Previous active VC/USD conversion oracle retained after the mutable USD-curve stack redeploy.

contracts.name: PreviousExponentialPremiumPriceOracle
contracts.description: Previous active VNS price oracle retained after the mutable USD-curve stack redeploy.

contracts.name: PreviousVNSRegistrarController
contracts.description: Previous active VNS registrar controller retained after the mutable USD-curve stack redeploy.

contracts.name: PreviousVNSBulkRenewal
contracts.description: Previous active VNS bulk renewal helper retained after the mutable USD-curve stack redeploy.

marketplace.title: VinuChain Name Service (VNS)
marketplace.shortDescription: Register and manage .vinu names on the VinuChain testnet.
marketplace.description: VinuChain Name Service (VNS) lets you register human-readable .vinu domain names on the VinuChain testnet. VNS is an ENS-compatible name system that maps wallet addresses, smart contracts, and metadata to memorable .vinu names.
marketplace.author: VinuChain
